name: Stripchat
summary: Sleek, fast-growing live cam leader pairing dark-mode polish and strong mobile streams with widespread interactive toy sync and dedicated VR cam rooms.
ranking_rationale: Chaturbate's sharpest challenger on product design: cleaner dark UI, strong mobile streaming, high room count, and real VR cam support.

pricing.free_tier: Public live rooms open to watch without buying tokens
pricing.notes: Token bundles and optional Ultimate perks vary by tier; check official checkout.

pros: Modern dark-mode interface with crisp thumbnails and fast filters
Huge global roster of solo, couple, and trans broadcasters
Widespread Lovense/interactive toy integration plus VR cam rooms
Smooth mobile web player with low latency
cons: Token spending escalates quickly in gamified rooms
Frequent pop-ups prompting registration or token top-ups
Some studio-run rooms feel less personal than indie cams

facts.value: Open public rooms with paid tokens for tips, privates, and fan clubs
Modern dark UI, mobile optimization, and live 180-degree VR cam rooms
